rule_text: the 3' base of the minisequencing primer is the base immediately 5' (adjacent) of the variant, so the first incorporated ddNTP is the allele
outcome_definition: the allele is read as the identity of the single ddNTP added 3' of the primer
source_file: PMC3482202 :: Results/Discussion; PMC3922441 :: Methods; PMC9971712 :: Table 3 caption; PMC13644189 :: Methods

rule_text: the primer position is fixed by the variant; only length, tail and strand are free design variables
outcome_definition: primer length and strand shift the peak; the 3' base cannot move

rule_text: hybridise the core primer over 15-25 nt of template (also stated as 18-25, 17-25); the 3' base stays the base before the SNP
outcome_definition: core length that the papers' tables print for working primers
source_file: PMC9971712 Table 3; PMC3482202 Table 2; PMC3922441 Table 3

rule_text: oligos carrying the same fluorescent label must differ by at least 3 nt (a 4 nt spacing was designed into one panel)
source_file: PMC3482202 :: Methods; PMC3922441 :: Discussion ('minimum of 3 nt')

rule_text: panels keep neighbouring extension products at least 4 nt apart (AmericaPlex26; also 4, 8 and 9 nt in the PAH panel)
outcome_definition: resolved peaks in the same dye channel

rule_text: poly(CT) tails are used to force at least 5 nt between products in the same dye channel
outcome_definition: resolved peaks in the same dye channel

rule_text: a non-homologous neutral sequence (or poly-CT / poly-T / poly-dC) is added at the 5' end, not the 3' end
outcome_definition: separation and balanced base composition of the extension products

rule_text: the tail is added only to reach the wanted size; Tm is computed on the core annealing region with the tail excluded
outcome_definition: Tm of the core only, so the tail does not change annealing

rule_text: multiplex amplification primers were designed to Tm 58-63 C
outcome_definition: mPCR primers anneal in one multiplex
SBE primers anneal at one extension temperature (50 C in the kit cycle)

rule_text: difference in Tm between SBE primers in one panel <= 3 C
outcome_definition: one SBE temperature works for the whole panel

rule_text: peak height follows template input and primer concentration; panels tune both
source_file: PMC2893629 :: Discussion; PMC9971712 :: Discussion; PMC7766892 :: Results

outcome_definition: peaks above the analysis threshold and below saturation

rule_text: minor/major peak height ratio < 0.1 marks allelic imbalance
outcome_definition: a heterozygote is called, not flagged as imbalance

rule_text: the two dye terminators of a heterozygote can differ strongly in height (A vs C reported as ~1:3.5)
outcome_definition: heterozygote gives two resolved peaks, not one dominant peak

rule_text: extension primers are screened for hairpins, self-dimers and heterodimers; 3'-end structures can prime template-free extension
outcome_definition: no background peaks from hairpin/dimer extension

rule_text: amplicon length is set by the template window that the primer sits in, not by a fixed ceiling
outcome_definition: the amplicon spans the variant with room for both PCR primers

rule_text: a multiplex SBE with the primer mix and no template is run to detect template-free products
outcome_definition: no peaks in the template-free reaction

rule_text: SNaPshot MultiReady kit: one premix carries the polymerase and the four fluorescent ddNTPs, so the four dNTPs are never user-mixed
outcome_definition: the dNTP constraint is kit-internal, not a design free parameter
